title: The Teardown 006 — The hook that asks before it greps
description: Graphify's Claude Code hook asks the repo map before every search, and in strict mode refuses the first raw file read of a session. We fed the guard fake tool calls on 2026-10-19: it blocks once per session, never twice, and never for a file edited after the graph was built. The decision chain, the settings fragment and a 14-line script that replays it on your own graph.
og_title: The hook that asks before it greps — The Teardown 006
og_description: Graphify's strict guard blocks the first raw read of a session, once. The five checks it runs first, the 14-line script that proves it, and the case where it never fires.
og_alt: A decision chain. A tool call enters the graphify guard and passes five checks: is there a graph (no: silent), is it a search (nudge, search still runs), is it a source file inside the project (no: silent), is the graph fresh for that file (edited since the build: soft nudge, never a block), any reason to let it through (not indexed, queried in the last 1,800 seconds, or already blocked once this session: nudge). Only a first Read of an indexed, unchanged source file with strict on and no recent query ends in a single deny.
